service.description: The ports other devices use to stream a game from this computer with Steam Remote Play / Steam Link (Valve's published list: UDP 27031 and 27036, TCP 27036 and 27037). Never open by default: once you switch it on in Settings > Remote Access, cosmos-steam-door opens it only while Steam is running (running firewall only, never saved, one-hour timeout that it renews) and closes it when Steam quits or you switch it off.
